response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS baseline_avg FROM group_averages), above_baseline AS (SELECT g.avg_instownpct, g.avg_instownpct - b.baseline_avg AS excess FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_instownpct > b.baseline_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS mean_group_average, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_above_baseline FROM above_baseline;
